question: Fit the Michaelis-Menten equation to calculate Vmax and Km with and without inhibitor, and plot both the Michaelis-Menten and Lineweaver-Burk (double-reciprocal) curves to compare enzyme kinetics.

expected_output.guidelines: TSV with columns condition, Vmax, Km; fitted values for Control and Inhibitor must match the reference within 10% relative absolute error; column order and decimal precision may differ.
Double-reciprocal plot with 1/[S] on x-axis and 1/V on y-axis showing both control and inhibitor series; colors, fonts, and styling may differ.
Saturation curve plot with [S] on x-axis and V on y-axis showing fitted curves for both control and inhibitor conditions; annotation style, colors, and fonts may differ.
